evidence.note: Authentication is UsernamePassword with the password field labelled API Key. Power Query supplies the credential, and no code sets an Authorization header or key parameter.
Web.Contents is called with only the Headers option (X-IRN-Source), so the key is not sent by connector code.
Data is fetched with Web.Contents against API_HOST.
The only shared entry function takes one optional record parameter, options. Its only use is the TestConnection flag.

options-fields.text: Only the TestConnection field, read as options[TestConnection]? = true. When it is true, the function returns Record.ToTable of the /group response instead of the navigation table.

evidence.note: options[TestConnection]? = true selects the Web.Contents probe of the group endpoint; otherwise NavTable is returned.
Each endpoint makes one Web.Contents call and parses it with Json.Document. There is no Table.GenerateByPage, List.Generate, recursion, or next-link handling.
Responses are read as text and parsed with Json.Document. Every endpoint works this way.
Table.TransformColumnTypes assigns M types to named columns of the returned note table (declared schema and explicit conversion). This path is reachable through the GetNote navigation item.
A second hardcoded column-type table, reachable through the GetCustomSymbol navigation item.
Table.TransformColumns converts relatedSymbols to type text, a per-column conversion of returned data.
Table.Pivot creates columns named from data values (custom field codes) with no declared M types.
Record.ToTable keeps the field names from the response, including fields beyond the typed ones.
The declared types apply to a single-note record. The code does not show whether an empty response keeps those columns, so the answer is unclear.
Live data requests use Web.Contents with no ManualStatusHandling option, so Power Query handles status codes.
The TestConnection probe also uses plain Web.Contents with no status handling.

The shared function has no Documentation meta. The Documentation.Name, LongDescription and SampleValues metadata is on the non-shared GetNotes/GetNote/GetMeeting and related function types (lines 226-251 and later), which are not shared.

The navigation rows are a hardcoded #table list of 20 items, each with IsLeaf true. They are built with Table.ToNavigationTable. Nothing is discovered from the API, and there are no folders or indirect rows.
TestConnection names the entry function FactSetRMS.Functions with the flag [TestConnection = true].
When the flag is set, the entry function branches to a probe that fetches the group endpoint, not the normal navigation table.
Table.NestedJoin runs locally on the fetched data. There is no Table.View, OnNativeQuery, ODBC, or OData folding.
All code is in one .m file, with no .pqm modules loaded.
Extension.LoadString supplies localized strings for the authentication label, data source label, and publish text.
Extension.Contents loads the icon PNG files.
Publish sets Beta = true.
No live code calls Diagnostics.Trace. The traceparent header is not used.
All calls are GET reads through Web.Contents with headers only. There are no Action functions or request bodies.
